item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","instrument_review":"ARC-AGI-2 supports comparisons on unfamiliar grid problems under specified evaluation conditions. Its scoring and development are described, and marking tests exist. Broader reasoning claims, score stability and comparisons across revisions remain less supported. No assigned method beyond MESA was specified; this review applies its conditions to the supplied passage.","supported_claims":["The benchmark tests inference from examples: systems must produce complete output grids for new inputs.","Development included human difficulty assessment and duplicate-rule review, supporting deliberate puzzle selection.","Official scoring permits two attempts per input and averages input credit within problems, then across problems.","Public marking tests examine correct outputs, size errors, changed squares and missing outputs.","Verified evaluations record settings and impose spending limits, supporting comparisons within those conditions."],"documented_problems":["Exact grid matching gives no credit for a partly correct output.","Software awards partial problem scores, while the dataset reserves 'fully solved' for all inputs being correct.","The human study covered a larger puzzle pool, so its results do not all describe the final test.","Public puzzles are exposed, and hidden-data precautions acknowledge possible leakage.","Recorded corrections do not include recalculation of every affected AI score."],"missing_information":["Repeated identical runs and score uncertainty estimates are not supplied.","Systematic tests of changed prompts, presentation or software are not supplied.","The extent to which scoring tests establish complete marking accuracy and consistency is unclear.","Evidence linking grid scores to language, social interaction or real-world work is absent.","The complete public results archive was not checked, limiting confirmation of reporting completeness."],"reinterpretations":[],"closing_note":"No reviewer identity or separate review method was assigned. The distinction between a software problem score and a 'fully solved' problem requires care. Missing studies are treated as uncertainty, not evidence of failure.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The public test, official scorer and verified-testing rules are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rule inference, intended AI systems and comparative uses are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Example grids, new inputs and exact output requirements are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Verified settings, spending limits, attempts and single-run policy are described."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Input credit and averaging across problems are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring transformations from examples is linked to learning new rules."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Origins and human difficulty selection are explained; broader representativeness is unestablished."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and corrections show checks, but complete reference-answer checking is unclear."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid tasks address rule inference but do not establish coverage of broader intelligence."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact outputs demonstrate task success, but partial understanding earns no grid credit."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Averaging is explicit, but support for its interpretation is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public tests check several marking cases; complete accuracy and consistency testing is unestablished."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI results and human difficulty data provide context, but human results cover a larger pool."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run; no repeated-run study is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Score variation estimates or ranges are not supplied."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Search-resistant design and repeated-rule checks address some unintended routes."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exposure monitoring and provider agreements address risk without establishing its elimination."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed; evaluation-specific adaptation and feedback-driven iteration are discouraged."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No predictive study beyond grid problems is supplied."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching help; other testing routes can differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public tasks, software and tests support inspection; hidden tasks remain controlled."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, handling and review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Corrections and code changes are recorded without recalculating every affected score."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-performance claims are supported; broader intelligence connections remain unresolved."}]},{"benchmark":"designqa","instrument_review":"DesignQA supports comparisons on its specified engineering-document tasks, with results depending on information supplied and marking rules. Practical materials support relevance, while uneven coverage, scoring artifacts and incomplete reproducibility limit broader conclusions and close rankings. No assigned method beyond MESA was specified; this review applies its conditions to the supplied passage.","supported_claims":["The benchmark assesses six described tasks using rules, vehicle images and drawings.","Real competition materials and practitioner contributions support relevance to parts of engineering work.","Development included additional review of manually written questions, subject to stated exceptions.","Changes to passages, labels, scale bars and highlighted images were tested.","Public questions, instructions, code and some responses support examination of parts of the evaluation."],"documented_problems":["Task coverage is narrow and uneven: individual-rule retrieval has 1,192 questions, while performance checking has 16.","Wording, formatting and omissions from reference answers can affect credit for valid responses.","Systems receive different information supplies, complicating comparisons of the underlying AI systems.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, allowing an always-yes strategy to earn decision credit on that portion.","The overall score equally weights groups with different sizes and marking methods without established skill interpretation.","Historical inputs and software are incompletely linked to results, and one answer file has fewer rows than the paper's question count."],"missing_information":["Complete marking accuracy and consistency validation, reviewer disagreement rates and remaining error rates are not established.","Repeated identical-run evidence and sufficient uncertainty information for close rankings are absent.","A human-engineer baseline and evidence predicting performance on other documents or projects are absent.","A protected test set, systematic overlap checks and clear training or repeated-submission rules are not established.","A clear account of revision effects, a licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found."],"reinterpretations":["In reported comparisons, 'AI' denotes the model together with its information supply, including retrieved passages where used; results therefore do not isolate the model's ability."],"closing_note":"No reviewer identity or separate review method was assigned. Variation across different passage sets does not answer the identical-run question. Missing licence information does not establish that reuse is prohibited.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, question count, groups and public scorer are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, AI systems and intended comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inputs, six task types and required answer formats are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but historical conditions are incompletely linked to results."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text matching, decision scoring and equal group weighting are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Tasks are linked to activities involved in interpreting engineering documents."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Practical origins are justified, but narrow coverage and uneven group sizes limit the selection rationale."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked questions, with exceptions and limited explanation review."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six relevant tasks are covered within one rulebook and a limited task range."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions earn credit, but wording and reference omissions also affect scores."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal weighting is described, but evidence supporting aggregate or separate skill interpretations is absent."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Small marking tests show some checking without complete validation."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random and AI baselines provide context; human-engineer results are absent and information supplies differ."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the conditions and do not establish identical-run variation."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Passages, dimension labels, scale bars and image highlighting were varied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Reported information is insufficient to assess small differences confidently."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and familiarity were examined, but unintended scoring routes were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Novelty and possible exposure are discussed; systematic overlap checks and protected evaluation are unestablished."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear training and repeated-submission rules were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No evidence links scores to other technical documents or real engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information differences are disclosed, but systems do not receive equivalent inputs."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials permit inspection but cannot reproduce every reported result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores are not clearly documented."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges limits; broad competence claims and close rankings require additional support."}]}]}
